newsitem.title: PERU: Peru signs $768 mln debt accord with United States.
newsitem.headline: Peru signs $768 mln debt accord with United States.

text.p: The Peruvian government said Tuesday it had reached a $768 million debt restructuring accord with the government of the United States.
The accord was part of Peru's bilateral negotiations to restructure its debt with the Paris Club of creditor nations.
The Economy Ministry said in a statement the debt would be serviced over 23 years at interest rates "lower than the rates agreed" in the previous debt contracts.
The accord also allowed a grace period before payments were due to start in 2001, the ministry said.

The agreement was one of a series of bilateral restructuring accords Peru was negotiating since signing a preliminary restructuring agreement in July with 14 countries belonging to the Paris Club of creditors.
